provenance: Developmental revision, not external preregistration. R16 reanalysis is retrospective. R16 MATCHED_COST_PLAN is executed as a separately identified follow-up. New structural tests are deliberate theorem checks.
primary_theory: Global resource-price/value-gradient bridge with exact Bregman identity on the full accepted polyhedron
Inexact-response regret with separately certified base gap and actual implemented repair
Conditional uniform frozen-fleet gain, distinct from each constituent model and the training population

boundary_design.targeted_events: Every instance in a named targeted stratum must actually exhibit the event; fail rather than omit.

nonquadratic_design: 64 exact rational scalar quartic-coupling cases with switching and box boundaries; both the Bregman identity and inexact bound are checked.

matched_cost.previous_state: Separate workspace for each requested target; no cross-target within-context warm start.
matched_cost.offline: All 256 label computations and all seven fits for every cohort, same host as online study; frozen deployment models unchanged.

publication: Complete ordinary TeX and actual PDFs, response, preservation map, raw results, manifest, and exact-final-SHA validation; publish only to a new R19 revision branch.
